Government Approves Electronics Component Projects Worth Over Rs 7,800 Crore

The Indian government has approved 31 applications for electronics component manufacturing projects with an investment of Rs 7,877 crore. These approvals were granted under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS). The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) cleared these proposals, which are expected to boost domestic manufacturing. One outlet also reported that 396 infrastructure schemes valued at Rs 18.66 lakh crore were recommended for approval under the PM GatiShakti initiative.
